quote: On June 5, 2019, Marvell Technology Group Ltd. (the "Company") issued a warrant to purchase nine million (9,000,000) (subject to adjustment in certain cases) of the Company's common shares, $0.002 par value, at an exercise price of $22.63 per share to Arm Limited (the "Warrant").
